description: This file defines a class 'RelationalStorage' responsible for interacting with relational databases using ADO.NET. It provides methods for executing queries asynchronously, including reading data with 'ReadAsync' and executing non-query commands with 'ExecuteAsync'. The class appears to be part of a larger Orleans project with multiple possible database-related namespace configurations, and it encapsulates common database interaction logic with support for cancellation and asynchronous operation.

classes.name: RelationalStorage
classes.description: A class for general-purpose relational database interaction using ADO.NET, supporting asynchronous query execution, parameter binding, and cancellation.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of RelationalStorage with specified invariant name and connection string.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a SELECT query, applies a selector function to each data record, and returns an enumerable of results.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a non-query SQL command (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL) and returns the count of affected rows.
